findings.title: Category subpages are absent
findings.observation: The snapshot has one flat rings.html page and no category subpages.
findings.requested_disposition: Add category indexes/pages or publish the unmet requirement as an open gap; do not claim a complete categorized catalog.

findings.title: Checklist narrows ring weight to metal-only weight
findings.observation: The generated checklist replaces the requested ring weight in grams with gold-alloy weight excluding stones/components.
findings.requested_disposition: Keep ring weight and gold-alloy-only weight as separate, explicitly labeled official-evidence fields; never derive one from the other.

findings.title: Calculator UI has no usable verified inputs
findings.observation: Both selectable products have null weight and null gold-price inputs; no user-input path exists, so every UI calculation remains blank.
findings.requested_disposition: Add labeled user-input controls and unit/source/date handling without presenting user input as an official observation; retain blank outputs for missing inputs.

findings.title: Audit does not validate every populated product claim
findings.observation: The audit checks source host plus price/metal/ID excerpts, but not name/category/karat/priceScope evidence; an allowlisted non-product URL can satisfy the generic row-link check.
findings.requested_disposition: Require field-level evidence and product-specific URLs, remove hard-coded review-date acceptance, and add negative tests for unsupported edits.

findings.title: Workflow actions use mutable major-version tags
findings.observation: The reviewed workflow references GitHub actions by major-version tags rather than full commit SHAs. The later main workflow removed deploy-pages but retains tag-pinned checkout/setup/upload actions.
findings.requested_disposition: Pin third-party workflow dependencies to reviewed full commit SHAs.

findings.title: Small eyebrow text is below WCAG AA contrast
findings.observation: The 10px #aa8135 eyebrow text measures approximately 3.3096:1 on #f7f7f1 and 3.5589:1 on white; ordinary text requires 4.5:1.
findings.requested_disposition: Darken the small text or otherwise meet at least 4.5:1 without rounding up to the threshold.

review_pass_policy: After every disposition or content edit, repeat official-source comparison, hallucination/security checks, build/link checks, and manual review of unresolved flags.
